Karthik — looping in revenue ops (Sean) and legal context. Short answer from prior quarter practice: we typically require either a fully executed PO dated within the quarter or a signed order/invoice dated within the quarter to close bookings. However, we have accepted strong evidence of intent (signed SOW + customer finance email committing to PO issuance with expected PO date) on a case-by-case basis after review by Finance.

Attached is a redline of ACME's PO template — nothing material from a legal standpoint but it is not yet fully executed. If the client can provide: 1) a signed SOW or order form, and 2) an internal QA email from their finance team stating the PO will be issued and dated X (with approver names), Finance has in the past allowed recognition when audit trail is solid. That said, this is borderline because month-end is tight.

I recommend the following options for the customer:
- Option A (preferred): client obtains PO approval and PO dated by 2026-06-30 -> we invoice and recognize in Q2.
- Option B: client provides signed order form + email from their procurement confirming expected PO date and approver; we do an expedited finance review for recognition.
- Option C: client delays to July 1+ and we recognize in Q3 (no workaround).

Please note we will need formal artifacts (PDF/email headers) to support any early recognition. Marissa

Hi Jane — thanks for the quick heads up. Two paths based on what Marissa confirmed:

1) If Acme can route the PO through approvals and have it dated on or before 2026-06-30, we will invoice and recognize the booking in Q2.

2) If the PO will be delayed past month-end, we can request one of the following to submit to Finance for an exception: a signed order form or SOW plus an internal procurement email confirming they will issue a PO and the intended PO date and approver. Sean — if the customer provides those artifacts before EOD 6/30, can finance do an expedited review to consider recognition?

Jane — can you confirm whether your internal approver will sign before EOD Tuesday (6/30) or if the earliest approval date is July? If July, we'll treat this as a Q3 recognition and update our forecast accordingly.

I'll follow up with a short mutual action plan to track the documents and signoffs so Forecast/RevOps can lock the quarter.
